parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: AppIds
parameters.description: The IDs of applications. Separate application IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: DbGrayEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable database canary release.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the lane group. A value of -1 is used to create a lane group. A value greater than 0 is used to modify the specified lane group.

parameters.name: MessageQueueFilterSide
parameters.description: The side for message filtering when the canary release for messaging feature is enabled.

parameters.name: MessageQueueGrayEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable canary release for messaging.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace.

parameters.name: RecordCanaryDetail
parameters.description: Specifies whether to record request details.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the lane group. The value 0 specifies that the lane group is disabled. The value 1 specifies that the lane group is enabled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse create-or-update-swimming-lane-group --biz-region cn-shanghai --namespace default --id 120 --name group1 --status 0 --entry-app mse-gw:gw-2b1407e050f1446xxxcd2a65fd9xxxx --app-ids xxxxn1po62@492b8f98d4bxxxx,xxxxn1po62@2d8f5d1b7f2xxxx --message-queue-gray-enable true --message-queue-filter-side Server --db-gray-enable true --record-canary-detail false --paths a --route-ids 111 --canary-model 1 --swim-version 2 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
